purpose: Group old/new HENGCE lines by lineage and show one display-only cross-lane attention score plus native entry/hold/exit status without mutating any model.

Q017_CANONICAL_FAMILY.rule: Group by ticker/provenance only. HENGCE_UNIFIED_Q017_CONTRACT no-score-fusion rule remains binding.

E2_PROFIT_MAX_FAMILY.rule: Only the named E2_PROFIT_MAX successor may contribute current evidence.

V43_FAMILY.current_stock_source: V43 latest valid independent screening output

X_FAMILY.rule: Never rerun X1-X15 merely to manufacture daily picks.

NEXTDAY_FAMILY.rule: Eliminated challengers contribute zero; Q1 contributes only when a verifiable current artifact exists.

members: Q017 x V43 x W1 resonance
RESONANCE_META.rule: Resonance is derived from underlying lanes and must not be double-counted into the attention score.

attention_score.why_equal_capacity: Avoid outcome-tuned discretionary weighting across incompatible horizons; each independent stock-bearing family can contribute at most one quarter of the display score.

state_mapping.Q017: CASH or no formal qualified buy => ENTRY_BLOCKED; a valid native formal entry => NATIVE_ENTRY_SIGNAL
state_mapping.E2_PROFIT_MAX: engine/action OFF => ENTRY_BLOCKED; valid native entry signal => NATIVE_ENTRY_SIGNAL
state_mapping.V43: daily Top3 when frozen schedule did not select the signal => WATCH_ONLY; frozen schedule selection => NATIVE_ENTRY_SIGNAL
state_mapping.W1: 40bp hard economic gate fail => ENTRY_BLOCKED; a future policy may only raise state after the hard gate and prospective requirements are satisfied
state_mapping.X_Q1_missing: INVALID_OR_MISSING for current stock score; do not rerun to fill the gap

economic_gate.rule: Expected value after 40bp total cost must be positive in each target year before W1 may independently be treated as entry-ready.

action_card.attention_leader: highest HENGCE_ATTENTION_SCORE_V1; ties remain ties rather than fabricating precision
action_card.buy_price: Only show a price/reference when a still-effective native line actually enables entry. Otherwise null / NO BUY.
action_card.hold_period: Use the winning native line's own horizon; never copy another line's horizon.
action_card.sell_price: Only show a fixed sell price if the native model defines one. Time-based exits must show their native time/session exit and keep target price null.
action_card.q017_cash_rule: Q017 CASH must be shown as canonical NO BUY; research watchlists may remain visible but cannot be relabeled as canonical entry.
